title: Grainfather Brew Session Weekly Boil Time Trend
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=grainfather:brew boil_min=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(boil_min) as avg_duration, max(boil_min) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst boil time for Grainfather brew session events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture boil_min on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average boil time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It times whether Grainfather brew session tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
